svg.title: Prospective source construction for 313 unit squares
svg.desc: The source-selected n=313 construction, normalized to Witness/v2 and drawn with the repository deterministic house renderer. This is a feasible construction, not an optimality or chunk-structure claim.

sqpack:profile.sqpack:value: Exactly verifies this canonical no-tilt construction. The source catalogue reports it as best known, but this witness does not prove global optimality, uniqueness, or the catalogue claim.

svg.text: U n=313 prospective source construction: side ~ 18 (certified upper bound)
